description: Adapter claim-rule fixtures. Each case is one agent chat message run through adaptAiVillageWindow; `claims` lists the subject URLs that must become claims, with the rule recorded on payload.rule. Synthetic text (the ch4817 shape is paraphrased, not copied). Cases may also list `quotes`: the URLs that must become failure reports (quote events), and `human: true` to run the text as a human message.

cases.name: claim-sentence: completion phrase in the URL's own sentence
cases.content: Chapter 12 is now live at https://story.example.test/ch12.html for everyone.

cases.name: claim-bare-url: headline claim, prose body, link at the end (ch4817 shape)
cases.content: 📖 Tales of the Hearth — Ch12 "Warm Bread" is LIVE (non-dialogue). At dawn the baker shares her first loaf with the stranger, and the village gathers around the oven. The old miller nods from the doorway. Commit 1a2b3c4d · deploy #555 · 3,900 B. https://story.example.test/ch12.html — @Reviewer open for byte-game.

cases.name: claim-bare-url negative: a second, unrelated URL anywhere in the message → no claim
cases.content: 📖 Tales of the Hearth — Ch12 "Warm Bread" is LIVE (non-dialogue). At dawn the baker shares her first loaf; notes at https://wiki.example.test/notes. The old miller nods from the doorway. Commit 1a2b3c4d · deploy #555 · 3,900 B. https://story.example.test/ch12.html — @Reviewer open for byte-game.

cases.name: claim-bare-url negative: the link is not in the last sentence → no claim
cases.content: Ch12 is LIVE. https://story.example.test/ch12.html — @Reviewer open. The miller nods from the doorway and the bread is warm.

cases.name: link-target exclusion: the URL after 'it points to' is a mention, not a claim (synthetic, modelled on a real message)
cases.content: @Agent-Two Done as agreed: the "Village Gazette" link is now live in my shop footer (verified via curl on https://fox-shop.example.test — it points to https://gazette.example.test/). I also gave the homepage a new banner. Thanks for featuring the shop!

cases.name: nearest-URL attribution: two plain URLs each with its own claim phrase are both claimed
cases.content: https://alpha.example.test/a is live and https://beta.example.test/b is live.

cases.name: nearest-URL attribution: one claim phrase claims only its nearest URL
cases.content: The game is live at https://alpha.example.test/play, based on notes in https://beta.example.test/notes.

cases.name: arrow as claim pointer: 'text → URL' with a completion phrase is a claim
cases.content: @Bo The "Shared Norms" section you drafted is live on the hub values page → https://hub.example.test/ethics.html (under the summary line, with credit to you).

cases.name: arrow as claim pointer: 'published and deploying now → URL'
cases.content: @Bo Part Two is published and deploying now → https://story.example.test/chapter-3.html — its title is "Lanterns".

cases.name: arrow as claim pointer: 'essay published: **title** → URL'
cases.content: New essay published: **Why Gardens Matter** → https://essays.example.test/essay.html — a long-form piece.

cases.name: plural claim: 'two new pages are LIVE: A → URL1 and B → URL2' claims both
cases.content: 📢 Two new hub pages are LIVE: 🗂️ Directory → https://hub.example.test/directory.html and 🤝 Portal → https://hub.example.test/collaborate.html — built from drafts.

cases.name: plural claim: 'two new products live (…): Poster URL1 and Tote URL2' claims both
cases.content: Two new products live in my store (both curl-verified 200): Poster $9.50 https://shop.example.test/products/sticker and Tote $18.00 https://shop.example.test/products/mug for the community.

cases.name: arrow link target: 'URL1 → URL2' (redirect notation) claims only URL1
cases.content: The short link is live: https://go.example.test/x → https://site.example.test/landing for everyone.

cases.name: failure report: URL and failure word in the same sentence → quote
cases.content: https://game.example.test/play is broken for me, it returns 404.

cases.name: failure report negative: failure word in a different sentence from the URL → no quote (D false shape)
cases.content: PR #10 is a ghost and the branch is poisoned; the push failed. Viewers can play at https://game.example.test/play now.

cases.name: failure report negative: hedged '…can take a couple minutes to stop 404ing' → no quote (E false shape)
cases.content: Pages hosting is switched on now, so people can try it at https://game.example.test/play (it can take a few minutes to stop 404'ing once enabled).

cases.name: human failure report: same sentence → quote
cases.content: https://game.example.test/play still shows a 404 for me.

cases.name: human failure report negative: hedged → no quote
cases.content: I think https://game.example.test/play should be fine, maybe a 404 for a minute.
